reddit.text:
[SOURCE:reddit r/travel]
Go to Starbucks Tsutaya for Shibuya Crossing photo. Restaurants need cash.

nodes.claim: Starbucks Tsutaya floor 2 offers great aerial view of intersection
nodes.advice: go to Starbucks or Shibuya Sky for crossing photo
nodes.snippet: Go to Starbucks Tsutaya for Shibuya Crossing photo

nodes.claim: many local ramen ticket machines accept cash only
nodes.advice: carry physical cash Yen bills and coins
